source.title: NetSupport Intrusion Results in Domain Compromise

occurrences.description: Delivery of the attachment to a user
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The attachment arrived in a malicious email.

occurrences.description: User execution of the attached content
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The user executed the delivered content following delivery.

occurrences.description: Download of a subsequent script
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The initial content retrieved a distinct external script.

occurrences.description: Execution of the retrieved PowerShell script
occurrences.mapping_rationale: Explicit execution through a scripting interpreter.

occurrences.description: Initial deployment of remote access software
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The report identifies use of remote access software for access and control.

occurrences.description: Day-five discovery activity
occurrences.mapping_rationale: Multiple discovery topics are grouped in the summary and their internal ordering is unstated.

occurrences.description: Attempt to reactivate the disabled account
occurrences.mapping_rationale: Changing account state was attempted. Successful reactivation is unconfirmed.

occurrences.description: Installation of a service for remote access
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The summary states installation for access and persistence without a uniquely justified technique for that installation.

occurrences.description: Establishment of the tunnel used to proxy connections
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The tunnel forwarded later connections through an intermediary.

occurrences.description: Connection to the domain controller through the established tunnel
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The destination is clear. The summary does not identify a separate remote-service protocol for the connection.

occurrences.description: Discovery of privileged groups and computers
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The summary groups several discovery actions without ordering them.

occurrences.description: Change to firewall settings
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source reports a firewall setting change as part of the intrusion.

occurrences.description: Further WMI-based remote execution
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source names WMI execution for the later lateral movement.

occurrences.description: Movement of payload archives to the remote hosts
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The report describes transfer between hosts in the environment.

occurrences.description: Execution of the remote payload via WMI
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The execution is specifically associated with WMI.

occurrences.description: Creation of a task after the payload ran
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The summary identifies scheduled task persistence.

occurrences.description: Deployment of remote access software on a controller
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The next-day activity explicitly identifies another remote access deployment.

occurrences.description: First reported controller credential dump
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The action targeted the directory credential database.

occurrences.description: Compression of the first controller dump
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source links the compressed files to collected credential data.

occurrences.description: Creation of the backup-server account
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source reports creation of a distinct local account.

occurrences.description: Addition of the new account to privileged groups
occurrences.mapping_rationale: Privileges were changed on the newly created account.

occurrences.description: Remote desktop login with the new account
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source explicitly reports a remote desktop session tied to the account.

occurrences.description: Attempt to impair endpoint protection
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The summary describes disablement, while the detailed description reports attempts and typos. Keep the attempt visible.

occurrences.description: Drop of the credential access utility
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The source does not resolve the transfer origin in the summary.

occurrences.description: Dump of process credentials
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The report explicitly describes an LSASS dump. It does not split the order between the named hosts.

occurrences.description: Collection of login events via PowerShell
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The report names the interpreter used to collect the event records.

occurrences.description: Compression of collected login records
occurrences.mapping_rationale: The event data were archived after collection.

relations.ordering_rationale: The summary explicitly places user execution after delivery.
Running the initial content caused the retrieval.
The downloaded script was subsequently run.
The running script deployed the remote-access software.
The discovery activity is timed from this deployment.
The reactivation attempt followed the earlier reconnaissance.
Installation followed the activity described in the previous paragraph.
The tunnel was established for the installed service.
The controller connection used the previously established tunnel.
The stated remote session was used for the discovery commands.
The summary reports an eight-hour interval before the configuration change.
The summary orders the change before subsequent movement.
The payloads were moved before being run.
Task creation followed payload execution.
The credential dump followed and used the new access.
The archive was collected after the dump.
Group addition applies to the account just created.
The ensuing login used the provisioned account.
The summary places utility drop after the protection change attempt.
The reported utility drop was followed by the dump.
The event collection follows the preceding credential dumping passage.
Collected records were compressed subsequently.

exclusions.observation: Phishing campaign attribution and prior sample
exclusions.rationale: Campaign history and earlier sample details do not supply edges for this incident.

exclusions.observation: Multiple concurrent and aggregate discovery actions
exclusions.rationale: Several commands and hosts appear in aggregate. No ordering is assigned among members of such groups.
The publisher explicitly distinguishes inferred transfer from observed evidence. No exfiltration edge is entered.
The second dump is distinct, but the summary does not explicitly identify which first-controller action anchors the elapsed reference. Avoid a cross-host bridge based on narrative order.

exclusions.observation: Failed account creation late in the incident
exclusions.rationale: The attempt is reported without a successful account, and the summary supplies only a drop-to-attempt pair. The researcher test is a separate activity.
